Hi Elena — thanks for sending this over and great questions. Below are concise answers you can paste into the workbook; I also attached a short PDF with the same text. If you want a formal signed addendum (DPA) with residency-specific clauses we can route that through legal.

1) Regions / tenant placement:
- Hosted API: Customers can select the preferred region at account creation (US or EU). Default accounts are provisioned in the US (us-west region). Regional placement is configurable for enterprise customers; self-serve accounts may request region designation during onboarding.
- Under our standard hosted offering we do not host customer data in APAC by default; APAC options are available via dedicated/private deployments.

2) Retention windows (default settings):
- Request/response payloads (full transcripts): retained for 30 days by default and then permanently deleted.
- Operational request logs (metadata only — timestamps, route, model, token counts): retained 14 days by default to support debugging; aggregated metrics retained for up to 24 months for billing and product analytics.
- Model cache/KV state: ephemeral, stored in GPU memory or local ephemeral storage and not written to persistent object storage. Evicted continuously; not included in retention windows.

3) Erasure workflow (customer-initiated account deletion):
- Timeline: Initiation acknowledgement within 24 hours; primary deletion of live request/response data and logs completed within 7 business days.
- Backups & snapshots: encrypted backups are retained for 90 days by default; they are included in the erasure workflow and scheduled for purge within the 90-day retention window. We can accelerate backup purges for enterprise customers under contract with a documented SLA and verification report.
- Evidence: We provide a deletion certificate (PDF) showing deletion job ids and timestamps upon completion.

4) Replication & cross-region copies:
- By default, hosted customer data is NOT replicated cross-region; data remains in the selected region for the tenant.
- Certain internal control-plane metadata (non-customer-identifiable) may be replicated for monitoring and HA, but customer request/response payloads are region-scoped unless you opt into a cross-region DR configuration (enterprise-only).

Security controls & compliance notes:
- All persisted data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3).
- We are SOC 2 Type II certified; full report available under NDA.
- Customer-managed KMS is available for Private/Dedicated plans; hosted customers may request dedicated keys on a case-by-case basis.

If you want a succinct single-page answer set for procurement I can convert this into a PDF and send now — otherwise I can loop in Marissa (security) to sign off on the backup/forensics language.

Best,

Elena — happy to jump in. Quick answers to your follow-ups: 

- Backup purge acceleration: We can run an accelerated purge of backup snapshots associated with your tenant. Operationally, we launch a verified purge job; primary live data deletion completes within 7 business days and backup purge is executed as a separate job. For standard hosted customers the backup purge follows the 90-day expiry, but for contracted enterprise customers we commit to an accelerated purge and provide a verification artifact.

- Deletion certificate contents: Our certificate includes job ids, timestamps, and affected object identifiers. We can include a checksum/hash of the object id (not user content) as an audit artifact. If you need a cryptographic proof of deletion for content hashes we can discuss options with the security engineering team.

- Metrics: We only provide aggregated billing/usage metrics; message-level or transcript-level traces are never shared with Aurora/legal. We can provide monthly aggregates and per-route token counts with PII redacted.

I'll loop in Marissa to confirm the backup purge SLA language for the PDF.

Hi Elena / team — Marissa on security. Following Ben's note, a few concrete items from our side so you can finalize the questionnaire: 

Checklist we will include in the PDF:
- Tenant region: US (or EU) — confirm at onboarding.
- Default retention: request/response 30d, logs 14d, metrics 24 months, backups 90d (enterprise accelerations available).
- Erasure: acknowledgement <24h, primary deletion <7 business days, backup purge job submitted (enterprise SLA optional).
- Deletion certificate: includes deletion job IDs, UTC timestamps, and object IDs. We will provide a signed PDF; hashes over object IDs can be included as an additional artifact.
- Replication: no cross-region replication for customer payloads unless DR option is enabled.

Next steps: please confirm whether Auric requires accelerated backup purge as a contractual SLA. If yes, we'll prepare a short addendum and provide an expected timeline and verification artifact format (PDF with job ids + signature).
